name: Covenant The
overview: The covenant God made with Abraham, as depicted in Genesis 15, reveals His sovereign promise to give Abraham and his descendants the land to inherit. Abraham's inquiry about how he would know this promise would be fulfilled leads to a solemn covenant ceremony involving the division of sacrificial animals, underscoring the seriousness and binding nature of God's commitment. This passage highlights God's faithfulness and the unalterable character of His covenant, which serves as the foundation for the blessings and peace extended through Christ, the mediator and substance of the covenant.
